sloka: रावण आनन शन्काः च काश्चिद् रावण योषितः ।मुखानि स्म सपत्नीनाम् उपाजिघ्रन् पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-५८॥
transliteration: rāvaṇa ānana śankāḥ ca kāścid rāvaṇa yoṣitaḥ ।mukhāni sma sapatnīnām upājighran punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-9-58॥

translations.english: Some women of Ravana (overcome by blind passion) smelt again and again the mouths of their cowives next to them assuming it to be Ravana's.
